question: Do finite sampled compact-curvature amplitudes produce converged exact-graph profile pairs with resolved positive slope margins, and what is the size of their undivided source-compatibility residual?
model: Same projected-coordinate exact graph energy, kappa1, f0, regular pole, flat reservoir, normalized u=p/sqrt(1+p²).

parameters.source: c=epsilon*phi, phi=exp(1-1/(1-r²)) inside1 and zero outside

equations.source_quotient: c_prime/r=-2*epsilon*phi/(1-r²)^2 inside1, limit -2*epsilon at0, zero outside
equations.outer: v(R)=0, explicitly an approximate finite reservoir boundary
equations.singular_matrix: If solve_bvp used, put -3*w/r in S=diag(0,-3); do not evaluate 0/0 or duplicate singular term.

execution_scope: 18 nonlinear solves, 6 linear controls at same sigma/configurations, 2 zero-source controls at R8/tol1e-8. One bounded attempt; preserve failure and do not increase R/amplitude/nodes or add cases without new decision.
independent_reference: Solve the separate linear equation with RHS -phi_prime and compare with infinite-domain Bessel Green quadrature. For response a_sigma: a(r)=K1(lambda*r)*integral_0^r I1(lambda*s)*(-phi_prime(s))*s ds + I1(lambda*r)*integral_r^1 K1(lambda*s)*(-phi_prime(s))*s ds (second integral zero for r>=1, first capped at1); z=a/r with exact origin limit lambda/2*integral_0^1 K1(lambda*s)*(-phi_prime(s))*s ds. Do not compare finite nonlinear profiles to linear reference at machine precision.
required_outputs: Exact code/design hashes, Python/scipy/numpy versions, observed start/end times and input provenance.
Solver status/node counts, boundary values, max|u| and independent off-mesh residuals from interpolation derivatives, never substituting ODE RHS as the checked derivative.
Regular-origin residual via analytic limit, exact flux Q and Q/r off the pole, finite reservoir comparisons on the source disk.
Record v2 minimum and (v1-v2) minimum on4097 source-disk points including origin limits and edge; sampled signs are numerical evidence only.
Profile tolerance and reservoir refinement changes; linear-reference and zero-source control errors.

If all equilibrium checks pass, fixed g=c diagnostic K=D[-S*(r*g)_prime+r*(c*g+g²/2)] on source disk, its norm and K/epsilon³ across three amplitudes. K is a source-compatibility residual, not observation error or noise tolerance.

acceptance_thresholds.sampled_positive_margins: Both minima positive and exceeding10 times associated measured tolerance/reservoir change; report as sampled numerical robustness, not rigorous all-radius sign proof.

interpretation_limits: Finite R12 is not an infinite-domain proof; refined agreement bounds only observed sensitivity.
Chosen finite epsilon values are computational probes, not the analytic existence threshold.
Do not claim stability, global uniqueness, biological identification, calibrated observation noise or practical precision.
The accepted local theorem remains independent of solver success or failure.
If thresholds fail, retain inconclusive/failed computational gate and stop; no parameter fishing.
stop_condition: One independently reviewed numerical realization with declared convergence/controls or exact failure; no empirical inference or broader continuation sweep.

comparison_definitions.profile: v=u/r; sup norms on the same4097-point [0,1] grid including finite pole value. No pointwise relative p error.
comparison_definitions.relative_profile_change: For each sigma/epsilon, ||v_test-v_reference||_infinity / max(||v_reference||_infinity,1e-12). Reference is R8 fine for tolerance comparison and R12 fine for reservoir comparison.
comparison_definitions.absolute_profile_uncertainty: E_sigma=max(||v_R8_coarse-v_R8_fine||_infinity,||v_R8_fine-v_R12_fine||_infinity), in v units; this is observed sensitivity, not a rigorous error bound.
comparison_definitions.ordering_margins: min(v2_R12fine)>10*E2 and min(v1_R12fine-v2_R12fine)>10*(E1+E2). Sampled margins use same v units including origin/edge.
comparison_definitions.threshold_applicability: Exact nonlinear Q/r and graph thresholds apply to nonzero-epsilon nonlinear cases. Linear controls compare their separate linear equation/reference; zero-source controls use absolute norms. Boundary residual only tests prescribed finite BC compliance. R comparison separately measures reservoir sensitivity.
comparison_definitions.residual: Use independent interpolation derivatives at points off the adaptive mesh, with dense source-disk coverage and full [0,R] coverage; report grid/count. At zero evaluate Q/r by its analytic pole limit. Never compute second derivative by substituting the ODE RHS into the residual.
